scoring_justification: The main result is a set of fixed physical constants produced by a macroscopic model; a result-level comparison with tolerances is appropriate. No directional metric exists, so a symmetric window is correct.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference values for the nine required physical constants.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Sections V.1 (Debye temperatures), V.3 (compressibilities), V.4 (elastic constants and Grüneisen constants).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted verbatim from the paper's reported numbers and converted to SI units (e.g., χ values reported as ×10⁻¹¹ Pa⁻¹ are written as true Pa⁻¹).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper claims for MnSb₂O₄; every quantity has a precise location in the source paper.

outputs.description: Reproduced anisotropic thermoelastic quantities: Debye temperatures (Θ_a, Θ_c), compressibilities (χ_a, χ_c), elastic compliance factors (S_A, S_AC, S_C), and Grüneisen constants (γ_a, γ_c).
